reason: windows-hook-gates red on PR #100: test_windows_delegation_launches_and_reaps injects HOME to point delegate at the fake companion, but Windows Python resolves Path.home() via USERPROFILE (HOME is ignored since 3.8), so the delegate under test found no companion and exited before any ledger row — KeyError launch_status after the 10s poll. Test-only fix: also inject USERPROFILE (harmless on POSIX) and surface the delegate's stdout/stderr in the assert for future diagnostics.
